name: Lords of Waterdeep

categories.label: Quests
categories.help: Victory points from the quests you completed.

categories.label: Buildings
categories.help: Points collected from buildings you built or used.

categories.label: Adventurers
categories.help: One point for each adventurer cube left in your tavern.

categories.label: Coins
categories.help: One point for every full pair of coins you hold.

categories.label: Lord of Waterdeep bonus
categories.help: Bonus points from your secret lord card.

categories.label: Gold
categories.help: Gold coins you hold; the most wins a tie.

notes: Tie-break: most gold. Coins score one point per full pair, so enter pairs for scoring and total gold for the tie-break.
